title: Continue to show menus for the previously-focused window when focus is lost to the panel or one of its widgets
line: The Global Menu keeps showing the app's menus while the launcher, system tray or another panel popup is open.
explanation: The Global Menu shows the menu of the task manager's active task. Panel popups are plasmashell windows that are not tasks, so when one takes focus there is no active task and the menu was cleared (the widget even hid itself, shifting the panel layout). The model now remembers the last active task and keeps using it while the focus is on a plasmashell window other than the desktop; it also re-checks on plasmashell's focus changes, since the window activation and the focus change can arrive in either order. Clicking the desktop still clears the menu, as Nate suggested in comment 1.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: keep the last window's menu while the panel has focus

Opening a panel popup such as the launcher or the system tray took focus
from the app, so the Global Menu emptied. Keep showing the last app's
menus while a panel or one of its popups has focus, but not the desktop.

BUG: 481686
